text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
When Mejiro Dober sees how<n>popular Air Groove
is with the crowd,<n>she realizes she's far from the
legacy she dreams of forging, but she<n>manages to
keep her spirits up.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Mejiro Dober can't quite conceal her<n>admiration
for Air Groove as she<n>vows to get closer to her
ideal.
